edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the transfer sender.
msg.sender allowance is spent in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the source of transferFrom in the Chire airdrop loop.
msg.sender receives the initial minted supply.
block.timestamp determines the early sell tax branch inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the router liquidity deadline.
tx.origin controls the per-block transfer delay check during launch.
from parameter drives blacklist, limit and tax branches.
to parameter drives blacklist, limit and anti-bot branches.
amount parameter is compared to limits and used for fee computation.
account parameter is written into the fee exclusion mapping.
recipients array iterated without length validation.
values array is scaled by 10**decimals before transferFrom.
newAmount bounds-checked then stored as swap threshold.
newNum bounds-checked then scaled into maxTransactionAmount.
newOwner becomes the privileged owner account.
newMarketingWallet becomes the ETH recipient in swapBack.
pair parameter is registered as an automated market maker pair.
tokenAmount is approved and swapped for ETH.
contractTokenBalance triggers the swapBack branch.
canSwap gates the call to swapBack.
takeFee gates fee extraction.
fees amount computed by mul/div and subtracted from amount.
isBuy selects buy versus sell tax handling.
success captures the low-level call result.
contractBalance is capped and split in swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap is the divisor for distribution math.
liquidityTokens halves the liquidity portion.
amountToSwapForETH is passed to swapTokensForEth.
ethBalance is split between marketing, dev and liquidity.
Fee accounting arithmetic executed on every taxed transfer.

Router addLiquidityETH external call with zero minimums.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to drive the _transfer override logic and should be merged into it.
The to parameter only exists to drive the _transfer override logic and should be merged into it.
The amount parameter is only consumed by the _transfer override.
The account parameter is only used to write the fee exclusion mapping in excludeFromFees.
The recipients array is only used by the Chire airdrop loop.
The values array is only used by the Chire airdrop loop.
newAmount is only validated and stored by updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
newNum is only validated and stored by updateMaxTxnAmount.
newOwner is only used to reassign ownership in transferOwnership.
newMarketingWallet is only assigned to the marketing wallet state variable.
The pair parameter only feeds the AMM pair registration path.
tokenAmount is only used in the router swap call inside swapTokensForEth.
contractTokenBalance is a local read used solely for the swap decision in _transfer.
canSwap is a local flag computed and consumed only in _transfer.
takeFee is a local flag consumed only in _transfer.
fees is a local computed and consumed only inside the fee logic of _transfer.
success only stores the low-level call result inside swapBack.
contractBalance is a local token balance used only by swapBack math.
totalTokensToSwap is a local denominator used only in swapBack.
liquidityTokens is a local split value used only in swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is a local input to the swap call inside swapBack.
ethBalance is a local amount distributed inside swapBack.
isBuy is a local flag computed and used only in the tax branch of _transfer.
